_meta.source: C1 (M5) per-split prevalence, mirrored from run_split_ablation's data prep (no training). Random StratifiedKFold folds carry the pooled prevalence by construction. Reproduction gate: geographic n_test equals the frozen split_comparison matrix geographic entry.

note: The geographic test set has the HIGHER base rate, so the prevalence difference biases the random-vs-geographic AUPRC gap conservatively (against the leakage claim), not in its favor.
